source:
Steamsaws use steam pressure to rotate a serrated metal blade at high speed.
Those struck suffer severe lacerations and bleed for 10% of the damage done per turn for 5 turns (stacking).
They can be wielded in the main or off hand.
Vrmmmmm!
target:
蒸汽链锯利用蒸汽压力驱动锯齿状金属刀片高速旋转。
被蒸汽链锯击中的目标将会受到严重割伤，在5回合内每回合受到相当于10%所造成伤害的流血伤害，可以叠加。
能装备在主手或者副手。
滋滋滋！！！

source: Through a combination of magic and airborne probes, these shots incite powerful bolts of lightning to strike your target from above, frying them and those around them!
target: 这些弹药通过魔法和探针从天空引导强力的闪电冲击你的目标，灼烧目标及周边的单位！

surface_observation: “Detonator”指起爆装置，译文“爆弹”指爆炸物，两者所指不同。

source:
By all accounts, just an ordinary cooking pot with an array of antennae haphazardly soldered onto it. An attached manual contains nothing but fifty pages of deranged gibberish, nonsensical diagrams and lines upon lines of numbers with no apparent pattern or reason to them. 

Putting this on your head may not be the best idea.
target:
不论怎么看，这都只是一口普通的烹饪锅，上面胡乱焊着一排天线。附带的手册有整整 50 页，却只有癫狂的胡言乱语、毫无意义的图示，以及一行又一行看不出任何规律或理由的数字。

把它戴在头上或许不是个好主意。

source: #OLIVE_DRAB#You carefully pickup the stack of herbs.
Coat your weapon in a substance that will react destructively on impact, causing your attacks to burst out in an area.
target: 在你的武器上覆盖一种物质，它会在撞击时造成破坏性的化学反应，让你的攻击在区域内迸射出冲击波。

source: Deploy steam powered turrets to assist you in combat.
target: 部署蒸汽驱动的炮台，在战斗中为你提供协助。

source:
Throw a cone of flame with radius %d, dealing %0.2f fire damage.
		The damage will increase with your Steampower.
target:
喷射出半径 %d 码扇形的火焰，造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害。
		伤害受蒸汽强度加成。

source: Object held in your tail. It can be a steamgun or steamsaw.
target: 在你尾巴上装备的物品。可以装备蒸汽枪或蒸汽链锯。

source:
Dive into the sand and rush towards your target at up to range %d, gaining a free attack if you reach it.
		At the exit point, up to 9 sand pits will appear that last for %d turns (based on your Strength).
		You must rush from at least 2 tiles away.
target:
潜入沙中，朝最远 %d 码内的目标突进；若能抵达目标，则获得一次免费攻击。
		在跃出点生成最多 9 个沙坑，持续 %d 回合（受力量影响）。
		必须与目标至少相距 2 格才能发动突进。

source:
Fall.  Suffer.  Lose the hope that drives you, or whatever brutish instinct suffices for it in your abominable mind.  Feel the pain you caused me, and know that it will never, ever stop...  you can feel it eroding your will to keep going, can't you?

When your shattered mind succumbs to the pain you gave me, I will take it for my own.  I'll give you back just a little of the hope and love I took, so when you're a mere passenger in your own body, I can watch that light grow dark, as you watch your own body finding everyone you love and killing them slowly and painfully.  Their last words will be cursing your name, and you will be both powerless to stop it, and all too aware that it's your own fault for not preventing it sooner.

Then, and only then, will you fully understand what you did to me.
target:
沉沦吧。受苦吧。失去驱使你的希望，或者在你可憎的心智中充当希望的野蛮本能吧。感受你施加给我的痛苦，并明白这痛苦永无止境……你能感觉到它正在侵蚀你继续前行的意志，对吧？

当你破碎的心智屈服于你给我的痛苦时，我将把它据为己有。我会把你被我夺走的希望与爱稍微奉还一点，好让你沦为自己躯体中的看客时，我能看着那光芒逐渐黯淡，而你只能眼睁睁看着自己的身躯找到你所爱的每一个人，缓慢而痛苦地将他们残杀。他们的遗言将是对你名字的诅咒，而你既无力阻止，又无比清楚这一切都是你没能早点阻止的罪过。

那时，也唯有那时，你才会真正明白你究竟对我做了什么。

source: Doing so drains their old knowledge and they need to start afresh, gaining considerable strength in the process; for the good of the Prides.
target: 这样做会耗尽他们旧有的知识，必须重新开始，但在此过程中能获得强大的力量；这一切都是为了部落的利益。

source: For now, peace reigns.  You know that this will not last forever.  You may have repelled its vanguard, but the Kar'Haïb Dominion bides its time waiting for a weakness it can exploit; the smugglers' portals from Maj'Eyal remain undiscovered, and while neither you nor King Tolak has any remaining desire to take the other's continent, the fear of invasion will linger in the backs of your minds.
target: 眼下，和平降临了。但你知道这不会永远持续下去。虽然你击退了卡尔·亥巴帝国的先锋，它却仍在等待可乘之机；走私者们从马基·埃亚尔通往这里的传送门依然没有被发现。即使你和托拉克国王都已无意夺取对方的大陆，对入侵的恐惧仍会萦绕在你们心底。

source: Steam powers of the various objects of the world.
target: 世界上各种物品的蒸汽能力。

source: Mana coils can be attached to staves to improve mana regeneration and cast a lightning spell on spell hits.
target: 魔力线圈可以安装在法杖上，提高法力回复，并在法术命中时施放一道闪电法术。

deep_observation: tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/other.lua:1771-1775（来源未固定）：译文漏掉了几处内容。其一，原文把长出的苔藓称作专名「Nourishing Moss」，译文只写成泛称「苔藓」。其二，「special botanical shot」里的 botanical（植物性）没有译出，只剩「特殊弹药」。其三，「as it is the ammo」这句解释（技能本身就是弹药）被删掉了。此外，「造成 %0.2f 自然伤害对半径内的每一个敌人」语序是欧化句式。
source:
You fire a special botanical shot with your steamgun(s) at a target for 100%% weapon damage as nature.
		The shot will release spores which grow into Nourishing Moss in a radius of %d for %d turns.
		Each turn the moss deals %0.2f nature damage to each foe within its radius.
		This moss has vampiric properties and heals the user for %d%% of the damage done.
		This talent does not use ammo as it is the ammo.
		Moss damage scales with Steampower.
surface_observation: 原文“This talent does not use ammo as it is the ammo”中的原因“as it is the ammo”未译出。
target:
你使用蒸汽枪发射特殊弹药打击目标造成 100%% 自然武器伤害。
将释放孢子生长成半径 %d 的苔藓 %d 回合。
每回合苔藓造成 %0.2f 自然伤害对半径内的每一个敌人。
这种苔藓有吸血特性，伤害的 %d%% 治愈使用者。
这个技能不使用弹药
苔藓伤害受蒸汽强度加成。

source: A clan of minotaurs turned to necromancy when faced with imminent destruction.
target: 一支米诺陶氏族在灭亡迫近时转而研究死灵法术。

source: The discovery of rockets has proved incredibly dangerous. It is not always clear for whom.
target: 火箭的发明被证明为极其危险。尚不清楚对谁。

surface_observation: “Detonator”意为起爆装置，译文“炸弹”改变了物品名称所指的对象。

source: This turret has been greatly enhanced.
target: 这个炮台被大幅强化了。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* The Pride is once again free and united.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 部落重获自由，更加团结。#WHITE#

source: #CRIMSON#The yeti is not hurt enough to control.
target: #CRIMSON#该雪人生命值过高，无法控制。

source:
A powerful salve that can clean physical detrimental effects from your body and grant a frost aura (cold, darkness and nature affinity).
To be used with the medical injector implant.
target:
一个可以清除你身上的负面物理效果并获得一个寒霜光环（增加寒冷、暗影和自然伤害亲和）的强大药剂。
需通过医疗注射器植入体使用。

deep_observation: tome-orcs/data/chats/john-surrender.lua:102（来源未固定）：原文「more useful alive and broken to me」里的「and broken」（一蹶不振／意志已被摧毁）被漏译，译文只剩「你活着对我更有用」。这个选项的残忍意味因此丢失，与上文 l.99 John 所说的「My life is destroyed」也不再呼应。
source: #LIGHT_GREEN#[bind him to the ring]#WHITE# No, you are more useful alive and broken to me!
surface_observation: 原文“alive and broken”中的“broken”未译出。
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#[将他绑定到戒指上]#WHITE# 不，你活着对我更有用！

source: Allows your weapon to spray caustic acid on hit, reducing armor.
target: 让你的武器在击中时喷出腐蚀性的酸液，降低敌人护甲。

source: All steamtech criticals reduce the remaining cooldown of a random steamtech talent by 1.
target: 所有的蒸汽暴击减少随机的 1 个冷却中的蒸汽科技技能 1 回合冷却时间。

surface_observation: 原文句末句号位于 #WHITE# 前，译文缺少句末标点。
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你收集了足够多的虫卵#WHITE#

source:
You cleanse your mind of %d mental debuffs.
		Cleansed effects will be randomly sent to closeby foes (range 5, subject to a mental save).
surface_observation: 原文两句之间有换行和制表符（\n\t\t），译文将两句合并，丢失该格式。
target: 你清除自身 %d 项精神负面效果。每项被清除的效果都会随机转移给附近一名敌人（射程 5；目标可用精神豁免抵抗）。

source: Knocks melee attackers away. Distance scales with damage incoming.
target: 击退近战攻击者。距离和其造成的伤害有关。

source:
Using small engines to augment your reflexes you are able to automatically fire retaliatory shots at your foes doing %d%% weapon damage.
		Retaliation shots are fired when you evade/are missed by a melee or ranged attack.
		This can only happen once per turn and uses shots as normal.
target:
开启引擎强化反射神经，你能进行反击射击，造成 %d%% 武器伤害。
		反击射击是当你闪避或躲闪近战、远程攻击时触发的自动射击。
		反击射击一回合只能触发一次，且照常消耗弹药。

source: A special shot that packs a punch.
As you left the Gates of Morning in ruins you noticed a strange powerful tremor that seems to come from nearby.
target: 当你离开晨曦之门的废墟，你注意到周围有一股强大的震感。

source: Fires out a bolt of cosmic energy in the target direction. The projectile continues until it hits a wall or the edge of the map, dealing %0.2f dark damage to enemies hit and restoring %d negative energy. The negative energy gained is reduced by 25%% per enemy hit, restoring a maximum of %d. Enemies hit will become aware of you.
target: 向目标方向射出一道宇宙能量。直到碰到墙或者到达地图边缘，对敌人造成 %0.2f 的暗影伤害并回复 %d 负能量。负能量回复量最大为 %d，每击中一个敌人将少回复 25%% 的负能量，被击中的敌人将注意到你。
